headline: The Advisory Committee voted to recommend a preliminary $70.9 million FY27 operating budget and finalized guidance on school articles ahead of Special Town Meeting.
synopsis: The Advisory Committee voted 6-0 to recommend a preliminary $70,887,098 operating budget for FY27, which currently projects an estimated 5.3 percent average single-family tax increase while remaining under the levy limit. Members warned that out-year budgets face steep debt service costs and tightening revenues that could trigger overrides starting in FY28. The committee also refined its recommendations for the March 2 Special Town Meeting, advocating for a Neary School roof replacement and renovation study over more costly alternatives. Additionally, members reviewed municipal capital equipment requests from Public Works and discussed a deferred $1.1 million park improvement project.

highlights.title: Preliminary FY27 operating budget recommendation
highlights.why: The committee voted 6-0 to recommend a preliminary $70,887,098 operating budget to Town Meeting and the Select Board, keeping municipal department operations at level service.

highlights.title: FY27 budget model and future tax projections
highlights.why: The current model projects a 5.3 percent average single-family tax increase for FY27, but members warned that sharp jumps in borrowing costs could force an override in FY28.

highlights.title: March 2 Special Town Meeting advisory report
highlights.why: Members drafted guidance endorsing a Neary School roof replacement and renovation study while opposing wider elementary school studies that could increase override risks.

highlights.title: DPW capital requests and vehicle deferral
highlights.why: Public Works sought a $235,000 truck replacement for snow operations but agreed a $52,475 dump truck purchase could be postponed if budget cuts are needed.

highlights.title: Fayville Park project deferred to fall
highlights.why: The proposed $1.1 million park project, featuring a splash pad and dog park, was moved to the fall Special Town Meeting to pursue grants and Community Preservation Act funds.

looking_ahead.what: Circulation of draft Advisory Committee booklet report for the Special Town Meeting
